message.content:
I’m not able to pull in live weather data right now, but here’s a quick snapshot of what you can generally expect in Hanoi:

| Season | Typical Weather |
|--------|-----------------|
| **Winter (Dec–Feb)** | Cool to mild temperatures ranging from 10 °C to 20 °C (50 °F–68 °F). Occasional cold fronts can bring temperatures down to around 5 °C (41 °F) during the night. |
| **Spring (Mar–Apr)** | Warm days with temperatures between 18 °C and 28 °C (64 °F–82 °F). Nights cool off to about 12 °C (54 °F). Rainfall starts increasing toward late April. |
| **Summer (May–Aug)** | Hot and humid, with daytime highs often above 30 °C (86 °F) and nighttime lows around 22 °C (72 °F). Monsoon rains are frequent, especially in June–July. |
| **Autumn (Sep–Nov)** | Mild to warm days, 20 °C–27 °C (68 °F–81 °F), cooling to 15 °C–20 °C (59 °F–68 °F) at night. Rainfall tapers off after September. |

If you’re planning a visit, it’s best to check a reliable weather website or app for the most up‑to‑date forecast closer to your travel dates.
